central-africa.title: Afríka ya Katikati
central-africa.description: Kongó-Kinshasa, Kamerun, Tshad, Repibiki ya Afríka ya Káti, Gabɔ́, Kongó-Brazzaville, Ginɛ́-Ekwatorial, Angola mpe Zambia — Kinshasa, Luanda, Douala, Yaoundé, N'Djamena, Lusaka; etando ya ebale Kongó mpe Rift Albertin.

south-central-us.title: Sidi ya katikati ya Ameriki
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi mpe Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson mpe Birmingham.
